title: Technical specification version 2
decision: Adopt the version 2 technical specification: HTTP API and chat contract, the schema in schema.sql with row-level security and an insert-only ledger, authentication only through Telegram identity with an administrator second factor, the role matrix, retention periods, performance targets NFR-001 to NFR-013, and the draft consent text subject to legal review
context: Rewritten for PRD version 2 after the change of direction (DEC-012, DEC-013). By founder instruction the agent decided open points without stopping; the founder reviews all six documents at the end.
rationale: Implements every live PRD requirement and every decision record; the schema was executed in PostgreSQL 16 and ten constraint, trigger, permission and isolation checks passed; performance targets are unmeasured and compliance items are unreviewed (EVID-027, EVID-033)
